notes: Landmark publication verified 2026-08-21: Vasaikar et al., Cell 2019, PMID 31031003 -- prospectively collected colon cancer cohort, paired tumor/normal proteomics+phosphoproteomics. PDC portal is a JavaScript SPA; exact study ID/case count/file inventory could not be fetched in this pass (deferred, not guessed). No download performed. PDC GraphQL API (pdc.cancer.gov/graphql, introspection disabled but `study`/`studyCatalog`/`filesPerStudy` queries work) queried 2026-08-26: **two distinct CPTAC colon studies exist in PDC, not one** -- `PDC000111` ("TCGA Colon Cancer Proteome", study_submitter_id "S016-1", project "CPTAC2 Retrospective", 90 patients/95 samples, Label Free) is, per its own study_description, the Zhang et al. Nature 2014 (doi:10.1038/nature13438) TCGA-based cohort -- a DIFFERENT, earlier publication than the one this registry cites. The methodologically/sample-count-matching study for Vasaikar et al. 2019 is instead a 3-study group under project "CPTAC2 Confirmatory", study_submitter_id "S037-1/2/3": `PDC000109` ("Prospective Colon VU Proteome", Label Free, 100 cases), `PDC000116` ("Prospective Colon PNNL Proteome Qeplus", TMT10, 102 cases), `PDC000117` ("Prospective Colon PNNL Phosphoproteome Lumos", TMT10, 102 cases) -- matching Vasaikar 2019's own independently-fetched methods text (PMC6768830: 110 patients, 100 tumor label-free, 96 TMT tumor-NAT pairs, Vanderbilt + PNNL centers, phosphoproteome on a TMT subset). **One unresolved gap, not guessed at**: Vasaikar 2019's own text cites its data under the old (pre-PDC-migration) CPTAC Data Portal study ID "S045", not "S037" -- PDC's current study_submitter_id field for this trio says S037, and no S045-labeled entry exists anywhere in PDC's current 248-study catalog searched here. This is very likely a portal-migration renumbering artifact (the old Georgetown cptac-data-portal.georgetown.edu used different sequential IDs than the current pdc.cancer.gov catalog), not independently reconciled -- so this repository records the S037 trio as the strongly-indicated match by cohort/method correspondence, not as a byte-for-byte confirmed identity. File inventory obtained for all three S037-trio studies via `filesPerStudy`: PDC000109 (2,423 files, 665.6 GB), PDC000116 (1,080 files, 519.45 GB), PDC000117 (554 files, 140.78 GB) -- overwhelmingly raw/processed mass spectra and peptide-spectrum-matches, not usable without search-engine software, but each also has a small "Protein Assembly" category of already-processed CDAP TSVs: PDC000109's `CPTAC2_Prospective_Colon_VU_Proteome.summary.tsv` (5.6 MB)/`.spectral_counts.tsv` (35.7 MB)/`.precursor_area.tsv` (75.9 MB); PDC000116's `CPTAC2_Colon_Prospective_Collection_PNNL_Proteome.summary.tsv` (2.78 MB)/`.tmt10.tsv` (54.9 MB, likely a gene/protein-level TMT10 ratio matrix analogous to what this repository already uses for `PXD055821`'s DIA-NN matrix); PDC000117's phospho equivalents. **None of these files have been downloaded or inspected for target-symbol content in this pass** -- this is a real, concrete, not-yet-pursued activation path for Module D if `CPTAC_COAD` is ever promoted out of `SUPPLEMENT_FROZEN`, surfaced here for a future explicit decision, not acted on unilaterally.
